final_message:
I've written the discrepancy report, and the OM shouldn't go to investors as drafted: it has 45 discrepancies against the Indenture or within itself (6 Critical, 14 High, 16 Medium, 9 Low), plus 7 drafting problems in the Indenture.
Both of Terrence's issues check out, but two of his section cites are wrong: the waterfall is Section 5.01(a) (there is no 5.04(a)), and the Class C rate is in Section 2.01(e), not 2.03. Among the issues he didn't catch, the worst are the day count (actual/360 in the OM vs. 30/360), all five final maturity dates, the Defaulted Receivable definition (90 vs. 120 days), the Minimum OC Amount, the final CNL trigger step (5.75% vs. 6.00%) and the clean-up call threshold ($68.75M vs. $71.23M).
